_comment: Consumer-side ARD pin + vendor map for research-pipeline — the SINGLE source of truth for which ARD release this plugin's verification adapter adopts and where each upstream kernel artifact is vendored. Mirrors the upstream agentic-research ard.json (https://code.s-nc.org/Kevoun/ARD). The plugin's OWN semver (.claude-plugin/.codex-plugin/package.json `version`) is DECOUPLED: bump the plugin when the plugin changes; bump `adopts` only on an ARD version sync. Re-sync = re-copy the vendored_paths verbatim from the pinned ARD release, then run conformance. See docs/ard-adoption-plan.md.

vendored_from._comment: Vendored verbatim from nklisch/skills plugins/agentic-research (which vendors ARD's kernel). pin, don't fork — invoke via flags, never patch.

_vendored_paths_notes.kernel/discipline.md: Upstream ships the discipline body inside skills/research-discipline/SKILL.md (no standalone kernel/discipline.md file). We vendor the six numbered sections BYTE-IDENTICAL; only the wrapper above them is deployment-specific (names our /deep-research + /research-program orchestrators and our schema path). Re-sync = re-copy the six sections verbatim, leave the wrapper.

not_yet_vendored.kernel/templates/dispatch.md: NOT adopted as a file. dispatch.md is ARD's 9-field registration-declaration template for the research-orchestrator, which Option A does not adopt (we keep our own orchestration). Our /deep-research + /research-program carry their own decomposition/dispatch logic; the discipline-propagation requirement (ARD SPEC §5) is met by inlining research-discipline into specialist dispatch prompts, not by adopting the registration template.
